description: Split each incoming segment into pieces — Based on Length (equal pieces, remainder kept), Based on Ratio (proportional list), or Based on Strip Length (a centred strip + outer remainders). One handle per piece, or a single bundle.
instructions:
Cuts each incoming segment (open polyline) into pieces. MODES (`mode`)
• length — equal pieces of `pieceLength` (m); the final shorter remainder is kept.
• ratio — a comma list (`ratios`) → one piece per entry, sized proportionally.
• strip — a centred strip of `stripLength` (m) at `stripPosition` (%) → up to 3 pieces (before / strip / after).

One output handle per piece, or a single bundle (`outputMode`). Piece length / strip length / position are wireable.

NOTE: the live handle count is baked from the actual geometry after evaluation; before the first run a ratio-mode node shows a provisional handle count.
